symbols.name: coefficient count
symbols.meaning: The number of coefficients in the list being placed on the axes.
symbols.quote: Let $N$ be the number of coefficients in the list, and let $P$ be the number of axes.

symbols.name: axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of prime cyclic axes on which the coefficient list is placed.
symbols.quote: Let $N$ be the number of coefficients in the list, and let $P$ be the number of axes.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The prime length of the first axis; the lengths $L_1,\dots,L_P$ are pairwise distinct primes.
symbols.quote: Let $L_1,\dots,L_P$ be the prime lengths of the axes, pairwise distinct, so that $N = L_1 L_2 \cdots L_P$.

symbols.name: list position
symbols.meaning: A position in the coefficient list, an integer from 0 to N-1.
symbols.quote: Let $J$ be a position in the list, running from $0$ to $N-1$.

relations.quote: The map preserves [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) of length $N$; the source paper proves this for the placement, which applies here because the axis lengths are distinct primes.
It is implemented by [fast address interchange](address-interchange.md) steps.
